description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.

summary.one_liner: QwenPaw is a self-hosted personal AI assistant that runs locally or in the cloud, with skills, plugins, MCP tools, and connections to multiple chat apps.
summary.what_it_does: It provides a web Console, a full-screen terminal UI (TUI), and a desktop app (Beta) for chatting with an agent. The README describes a three-layer memory system built on ReMe, with conversations and resources stored as editable Markdown files. Agents can be given their own memory and skills, can spawn sub-agents, and can communicate through the Agent Communication Protocol (ACP). It supports multiple models, including a built-in QwenPaw Local runtime (llama.cpp), Ollama, LM Studio, and 14+ cloud providers, and it can connect to channels such as DingTalk, Lark, WeChat, Discord, Telegram, iMessage, and QQ. Security features include a sandbox, Tool Guard, File Guard, Skill Scanner, and Access Policy. Scheduled tasks, a file workspace, and MCP integration are also listed.
use_cases: run a private personal AI assistant on my own machine
send scheduled news digests or alerts to chat apps
manage a self-hosted AI agent with memory and skills
read, edit, and review code in project folders with an agent
convert and process PDF, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files
deploy a personal AI agent on a cloud server with Docker
how_to_run: pip install (Python >= 3.11): install the package and run the installer script (macOS/Linux or Windows PowerShell)
qwenpaw init --defaults (or qwenpaw init for interactive setup)
docker run -p 127.0.0.1:8088:8088 -v qwenpaw-data:/app/working -v qwenpaw-secrets:/app/working.secret -v qwenpaw-backups:/app/working.backups agentscope/qwenpaw:latest
From source: cd console && npm ci && npm run build; copy dist to src/qwenpaw/console; pip install -e .
notable: Three-layer memory with editable, searchable, linked Markdown files, powered by ReMe
QwenPaw-Flash local models (2B to 35B-A3B) trained for agent tasks, runnable with no API key
Single instance reachable through many chat channels (DingTalk, Lark, WeChat, Discord, Telegram, iMessage, QQ)
OS-level sandboxing (Seatbelt, Bubblewrap/Landlock, AppContainer) plus Tool Guard and File Guard
caveats: Desktop app is in Beta with incomplete compatibility testing and possible performance issues
Windows Enterprise LTSC or Constrained Language Mode environments may need manual PATH setup
Cloud model use requires an API key; local models need hardware resources and Ollama/LM Studio need separate installs
macOS desktop build is not notarized, so Gatekeeper warnings appear
keywords: run ai on my own machine
